notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Glorious Protector.
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Glorious Protector.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
